Class MainScene

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.client.view.gui.scenes.CustomScene
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.client.view.gui.scenes.MainScene
All Implemented Interfaces:
UI
public class MainScene extends CustomScene
Main window of the GUI, used for persistent elements across swappable scenes. Manages temporary overlays such as the game menu with rulebook carousel, loading screen, and reconnection prompt screen.
